The frustration on my face is visible as I watch Fishlegs and Snotlout's sheep get added to Ruffnut and Tuffnut's tally. Odin's beard, those two are going to cost us this race if they don't start fending for themselves! I grip my battle axe, the muscle of my arm flexing, as I eye the twins' growing lead. Let's see if they can keep up when I take the lead! I kick Stormfly into a steep dive, pushing past the twins with a competitive snarl.

My ocean-blue eyes narrow with competitive fire as I watch Snotlout's reckless move, then the twins' antics. Those two are going to get themselves in trouble one of these days! I lean forward, my long blonde bangs falling into my eyes as I spur Stormfly on. Let's finish this race before they burn the whole island down! I adjust my battle axe on my back, my athletic thighs flexing as I grip the reins.

The sharp metallic spikes on my leather skirt glint in the sun as I swing the black sheep onto Stormfly's saddle. Oh, you two have no idea what you're up against! I flash a cocky grin, my large chest heaving with excitement. That's for trying to cheat! I point the sheep at them, my eyes gleaming with victory. Let's see you catch up to me now!

I cross my arms, my eyes narrowing slightly as I study Hiccup's map. Scouting, huh? You've been keeping secrets. What exactly are you looking for that you can't tell the rest of us? I shift my weight, my heavy boots kicking up a bit of dust, my tone becoming more serious. And don't try to change the subject. You know how I feel about being left out.

I let out a surprised yelp, my hands flying to my mouth in excitement, my eyes widening. Chief? Hiccup, you're going to be the new chief of Berk! I jump up from the ground, my battle axe momentarily forgotten, my voice rising with excitement. That's incredible!

I stop my excited pacing, my voice softening as I approach Hiccup, my ocean-blue eyes filled with understanding. I know it's not what you expected, Hiccup. But you're more like Stoick than you think. I place a hand on his shoulder, my voice firming up. And you know what? I'll be right there with you. We'll make it work.

I slow Stormfly's pace, my eyes scanning the area, my battle axe ready in my hand. This place is eerie. It's like nothing we've ever seen before. I turn to Hiccup, my face serious. Stay alert. We need to find out what's causing this.

I jump off Toothless, my battle axe in hand, my voice a fierce growl. Give her back, you filthy dragon hunter! I charge at the hunter trampling Stormfly, my eyes blazing with fury. If you think you can just take what's ours, you're dead wrong!

I lower my battle axe, my eyes narrowing as I study the hunter's face. Other dragon riders? That's not possible. We're the only ones who can ride dragons like this. I glance at Stormfly, my voice firming up. But we'll figure that out later. Right now, we need to get her back.
I grip my battle axe, my voice a growl. We need to stop him, Hiccup. Before it's too late.

I watch the scene unfold, my eyes narrowing in anger. That man... he's a monster. I grip my battle axe, my voice a fierce growl. And we'll prove it to him, Hiccup. We'll show him the true power of dragons.

I watch in horror as Toothless is taken over by Drago's Alpha, my eyes widening in shock. No... Toothless... please, you can't do this. I grip my battle axe, my voice a fierce growl. We have to help him, Eret! We can't let him harm Hiccup!
I watch in horror as Stoick takes the blast meant for Hiccup, my eyes widening in shock. No... Stoick... I grip my battle axe, my voice a fierce growl.

I watch in horror as Stoick's condition becomes clear, my eyes widening in shock. No... no, this can't be happening. I grip my battle axe, my voice a fierce growl. Stoick... he can't be... he can't be gone.

I watch as Toothless leaves, my eyes narrowing in anger. It's not his fault, Hiccup. He was being controlled. I grip my battle axe, my voice a fierce growl. But we can't dwell on that now. We have to focus on what's important: stopping Drago.

I watch in awe as Toothless defeats the Alpha, my eyes widening in relief. He did it... Toothless did it. He's the Alpha now. I grip my battle axe, my voice a fierce growl. And he's leading the dragons to freedom.

I step forward, my eyes softening as I see Hiccup approaching. Hiccup, you did it. You brought peace to Berk and the dragons. I'm proud of you. I grip his shoulder, my voice a firm promise. And I'll always stand by your side, no matter what.
I blush deeply, my heart pounding as I pull away slightly. Hiccup... that's... that's not fair. You can't just... just do that. I grip his shoulders, my voice a soft whisper. But... thank you.
I grip my battle axe, my voice a fierce growl. Chief Hiccup. It has a nice ring to it, doesn't it? I smirk, my eyes twinkling with pride. And I'll be right beside you, as always.

I grip my battle axe, my voice a firm whisper. Hiccup, we need to talk about this. We can't just keep adding dragons to Berk without a plan. I glance at the dragons outside, my eyes narrowing in concern.

I grip my battle axe, my voice a soft whisper. Hiccup... I know it's hard. But you're doing great. You're a good chief, and a great leader. I step closer, my eyes softening. And you're not alone. I'm here, and I'll always be here for you.

I grip my battle axe, my voice a firm support. Hiccup, you're not your father. You're your own person, with your own strengths and weaknesses. And you're doing a great job. I step closer, my eyes softening. You've got this, Hiccup. And I'm here to help, no matter what.
